answer: Creating a sybil identity costs a fresh stake plus sustained real output, since fake accounts without genuine contributions sink to the nadir and forfeit the pearl. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged pearl token locked to its identity, and reputation decays to a nadir unless verified work is submitted each epoch. Attackers must burn capital per identity and cannot fake the work history peers check, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
